text: まずは　つかまえる　ポケモンの　たいりょくを　へらすんだ

structure.jp: まずは　つかまえる　ポケモンの　たいりょくを
structure.en: first, the HP of the Pokémon you'll catch

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: つかまえる　ポケモン
patterns.explanation: A plain verb placed before a noun describes that noun. つかまえるポケモン = 'the Pokémon you will catch'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ explains or instructs in a friendly way. へらすんだ = 'you should lower it'.
